messages:
Ashwin: Heads up — our AWS Savings Plan / RI review is due in 29 days. I pulled the last 90d GPU consumption and there's a mismatch between committed capacity and actuals, especially for p4d vs g5 families. Can ops-analytics confirm utilization numbers?
Marta: I can run the queries now, brief summary: overall RI/Savings coverage for GPU-tagged instances is ~68% last 90d, but region split matters — us-west-2 is at 85%, us-east-1 at 54%. Nightly idle hours look bad for us-east-1.
Kevin: Do we have a breakdown by instance family? p4d (A100) vs g5 (A10G/H100) will affect whether convertible RIs or regional savings give value.
Ops-Analytics: Quick Athena snippet I used to get committed vs actual usage (paste):
```sql
SELECT product_instance_type, availability_zone, SUM(hours_on) as used_hours, SUM(reserved_hours) as reserved_hours
FROM gpu_billing_exports
WHERE usage_start >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
GROUP BY product_instance_type, availability_zone
ORDER BY used_hours DESC
```
Ops-Analytics: Results (rounded): p4d: used 12.6kh / reserved 9.8kh (util 78%), g5.12xlarge: used 7.1kh / reserved 5.0kh (util 70%), g5a: used 4.2kh / reserved 6.8kh (util 62% but skewed because of region mismatches), h1-like spikes for batch in eu-west-1 not covered.
Devon: So us-east-1 underutilization is mostly g5a reservations that teams spun up in Q3 and didn't fully use. Can we reassign reservations cross-account or convert?
Marta: For AWS: regional Convertible RIs give some flexibility but you lose some savings vs Standard. Savings Plans are simpler but don't always cover specific GPU instance types unless using Compute SP (covers instance family/region differences).
BillingBot: Note: convertible RIs for GPU instance families have restrictions; make sure instance size flexibility applies — check `instanceFamily` vs `instanceType` in the billing report.
Lucy: Ops suggestion: 1) Rightsize or sell/modify underused RIs where possible; 2) Buy targeted compute Savings Plans for baseline non-spiky GPU workloads; 3) Use short-term Reserved capacity (1yr partial upfront) for steady batch nodes we can predict.
Kevin: I ran a quick ROI calc: moving 2.1k reserved hours from g5a in us-east-1 to a 1yr SP would cost an extra ~$9k but reduce mismatch overhead by ~18% given our projected ramp. Worth it if we keep current growth.
Ashwin: Risk check — any constraints on moving reservations across accounts/projects? We have shared billing but multiple linked accounts.
Ops-Analytics: You can use regional commitments to cover across linked accounts in consolidated billing, but zonal RIs are stuck. We have ~14 zonal reservations in us-east-1 that are idle overnight.
Marta: Actionable plan proposal: (A) Sell/modify 8 of the underused zonal RIs in us-east-1 before renewal cutoff; (B) purchase 12-month Compute Savings Plan to cover baseline p4d + g5 steady usage (partial-upfront if cash ok); (C) add a nightly auto-stop policy for dev/test GPU autoscaling groups to recover ~20% of wasted hours.
Devon: I can implement auto-stop and tag enforcement for dev/test by EOD Friday. That should shave 1.6k hours/month.
Lucy: I'll coordinate with Finance on the cashflow impact of partial-upfront vs all-upfront and run the amortized cost model.
Ashwin: OK — assign owners: Devon (auto-stop + tags), Lucy (finance/commitment plan), Marta (RI modification list + tickets to AWS for exchange), Ops-Analytics (final utilization report w/ CSV). We'll reconvene in 4 business days to decide on buy/sell. :thumbsup:
Kevin: One more thing: add a short Athena query to identify instances missing cost-center tags so we can attribute underutilization to teams before we reassign commitments.
Ops-Analytics: Adding that to my list. Query snippet: `SELECT resource_id, tags['CostCenter'] FROM resource_tags WHERE tags['CostCenter'] IS NULL AND created_at > date_add('month', -6, current_date)`
BillingBot: Reminder: don't forget the 7-day cancellation window for conversions with AWS marketplace — document everything in the ticket.
Ashwin: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the decision meeting. If anyone hits blocking data gaps ping me here.
Marta: FYI — linked console view: https://console.aws.amazon.com/billing/home#/savings-plans (share with team)
Kevin: +1, will prepare comparison spreadsheet of 1yr vs 3yr options and expected payback.
Devon: Starting tag sweep now.
Lucy: Finance will have numbers by tomorrow morning.
Ops-Analytics: Uploaded CSV to S3: s3://redwood-cost-reports/ri-review/1783001234/utilization.csv
Ashwin: Great work, team. :rocket:
